name: In'en no Yu ~Sandai no Okami-tachi to no Mikkou~
original_name: 淫艶の湯 ～三代の女将達との密交～
source:
Tatsuhito is working in an inn that is owned by his wife's family working together with his sister-in-law Mako, his mother-in-law Mizuho, who is the current landlord of the inn, and his grandmother-in-law Nanao. His wife recently gave birth to their first child and as a result their sex life decreased considerably.

After an exhausting work day at the inn he comes across an hyponsis program while playing around with his smart phone.
Not believing in such nonsense he shows it to Mako who jokingly proposes that Tatsuhito uses it on herself, Mizuho and Nanao with the condition that they'll always get horny when they see Tatsuhito. 

Surprisingly the program works too well and now Tatsuhito has to fend off the advances of his relatives.
translation:
龙仁与嫂子真子、现任旅馆老板的婆婆瑞穗以及祖母七绪一起在妻子家族开办的旅馆里工作。他的妻子最近生下了他们的第一个孩子，因此他们的性生活大大减少。

在旅馆劳累了一天后，他在玩智能手机时发现了一个催眠程序。
他不相信这种胡言乱语，他把它拿给真子看，真子开玩笑地建议龙仁在自己、瑞穗和七尾身上使用它，条件是他们看到龙仁时总是会兴奋。

令人惊讶的是，该计划效果太好了，现在达仁不得不抵制他亲戚的追求。
